description.en: The business tenant code. Default value: ALICOM_OPAAS.

description.zh: 业务扩展信息，默认为一个空集合。
description.en: The business extension information. Default value: an empty collection.

description.zh: 流程编码。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码。
description.en: The flow code. You can view the flow code on the [flow editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page.

description.zh: 流程版本。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入画布编排界面查看流程版本或通过[ListFlowVersion](~~2937202~~)获取流程版本。
description.en: The flow version. You can click a flow name on the [flow editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page to go to the canvas orchestration page and view the flow version, or call [ListFlowVersion](~~2937202~~) to retrieve the flow version.

description.zh:
流程版本状态。取值：
- DRAFT：草稿。
- DELETED：已删除。
- ONLINE：在线。
- OFFLINE：下线。
description.en:
The flow version status. Valid values:
- DRAFT: draft.
- DELETED: deleted.
- ONLINE: online.
- OFFLINE: offline.

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口查询流程版本，也可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入画布编排界面查看流程版本。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已成功创建流程。

- 若您没有创建成功的流程，可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面手动创建流程或通过[CreateChatFlow](~~2937204~~)创建流程。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to query a flow version. You can also click a flow name on the [flow editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page to go to the canvas orchestration page and view the flow version.

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have successfully created a flow.

- If you do not have a successfully created flow, you can manually create a flow on the [flow editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page or create a flow by calling [CreateChatFlow](~~2937204~~).
